reason: The plugin connects dsh sessions to BitFun as a delegated subagent through ACP v1 over stdio, exposing a configurable subagent tool and managing BitFun subprocesses for task execution.

summaries.zh: 通过 ACP v1 将 dsh 会话连接到 BitFun，使模型能够调用可配置的 subagent_bitfun 工具委托任务执行。
summaries.en: Connects dsh sessions to BitFun through ACP v1 so models can delegate tasks using a configurable subagent_bitfun tool.

capabilities: Registers a subagent tool for delegating tasks from dsh sessions to BitFun
Spawns a BitFun ACP subprocess for each delegated task
Communicates with the subprocess over stdio JSON-RPC
Passes configured environment variables and permission behavior to the BitFun subprocess
Detects the BitFun CLI and terminates the subprocess after task completion
